set_episode_image.description: Make a picture, e.g. new artwork in Dropbox, one of an episode's pictures, each in PNG or JPEG and exactly as big as it says, or it's refused: its THUMBNAIL (1920 × 1080), THUMBNAIL_B or THUMBNAIL_C (1920 × 1080), which go with its alternative titles B and C as they're A/B tested together, its WEB picture (1920 × 1080), the thumbnail without its words, for ogrodje.si, or its COVER (3000 × 3000, e.g. for podcast apps). In the Artwork folder in Dropbox, an episode's folder usually has its cover (...-podcast.png), thumbnails (...-thumb1.png, -thumb2, -thumb3) and web picture (...-web.png). MetaOS copies it to its public bucket, where anyone can see it, with copies of it 320, 640, 1280 and 1920 px wide (those narrower than it), and returns their URLs. Up to 50 MB. The copy stays as it is when the picture changes where it came from; setting it again makes a new one

set_episode_status.description: Move an episode through its lifecycle: IDEA → PLANNED → SCHEDULED → RECORDED → IN_PRODUCTION → READY → EARLY_ACCESS (optional) → PUBLISHED, one step forward or back to any earlier step; ON_HOLD or CANCELLED any time before it is published. Each step needs what the ones before it did, plus: PLANNED a code and a host, SCHEDULED a recording date, RECORDED one that is not in the future, IN_PRODUCTION a producer, READY a summary, EARLY_ACCESS any of its Patreon links, PUBLISHED a YouTube, Spotify or Apple Podcasts link. Publishing sets the aired date to today if there is none

set_patreon_post_media.description: Upload an episode's audio or video, from Dropbox or an https URL, to a Patreon draft: with AUDIO it becomes a podcast post, in the campaign's podcast feed, with VIDEO a video post. The gateway downloads the file itself and Patreon processes it, which takes minutes for an episode: this returns a job to follow with get_patreon_job

set_person_avatar.description: Make a picture a person's avatar, e.g. one from Hygraph, the CMS, or a photo in Dropbox or Koofr: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, of any size. MetaOS copies it to its public bucket, where anyone can see it, with copies of it 320, 640, 1280 and 1920 px wide (those narrower than it), and returns their URLs. Up to 50 MB. The copy stays as it is when the picture changes where it came from; setting it again makes a new one

transcribe_episode.description: Transcribe one of an episode's files with Google's Speech-to-Text (Chirp 3), in a durable workflow on Temporal: by default its full audio, else its full video, in the language its show's episodes are spoken in (Slovenian; Borderless's English) unless told another. Speech-to-Text takes minutes for an episode, or up to a day in a batch, for a fifth of the price; get_episode_transcript says how it's going and, once it's done, reads it. With chapters, an agent then posts the episode's chapters and summary as a comment, in the episode's language. Speech-to-Text doesn't tell speakers apart. A file with a transcript is transcribed again only with replace, which replaces it

batch.description: In a batch: within a day, for a fifth of the price; false by default

chapters.description: Have an agent post the chapters and summary as a comment once it's done; true by default

code.description: Episode code, e.g. S01E03, or the episode's ID (ideas may not have a code yet)

language.description: The language spoken in it, as a tag, e.g. sl-SI or en-US; by default its show's

media.description: The file's ID, from list_episode_media; by default the full audio, else the full video

replace.description: Replace the file's transcript, if it has one; false by default

transcribe_episode.title: Transcribe episode
